name: nist-csf-maturity-tool
description: NIST CSF 2.0 maturity assessment powered by Node.js

scripts.build:client: npm run prepare:client && vite build --config frontend/client/vite.config.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:client
scripts.test: node --test test/fileService.test.js test/personnelCertificationService.test.js test/policyRegisterService.test.js test/questionnaireTemplateService.test.js test/policyReminderService.test.js test/moduleTransfer.test.js test/smtpService.test.js test/auditFindingService.test.js test/auditFindingReminderService.test.js
